name: OKC_DELIVERABLES_H
description: OKC_DELIVERABLES_H stores deliverables present on a business document.   Each deliverable has a due date, either a fixed due date or relative due date. A relative due date is relative to an event in the lifecycle of the business document.  A deliverable can be one-time or recurring. A deliverable can be defined on a business document like Purchase Order, RFQ, RFI, Blanket Purchase Agreement or defined on a Contract Template and defaulted onto the business document from the contract template .  Deliverables can be one of the three types: Contractual, Internal Purchasing and Negotiation.    Each deliverable can have a responsible party (Supplier or Buyer Organization) and a contact for each. Note: Deliverables are only supported on Procurement Contracts covering the following document types: a)	Purchase Order b)	Blanket Purchase Agreement c)	RFQ d)	RFI and  e)	Auctions

columns.name: BUSINESS_DOCUMENT_ID

columns.description: Document Number for a Business Document. Example: PO_NUMBER, AUCTION_ID .

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_TYPE
columns.description: Deliverable Type for the given Deliverable. Some of the valid values are CONTRACTUAL, INTERNAL_PURCHASING and SOURCING. Refers to the deliverable_type_code in OKC_DELIVERABLE_TYPES_B.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_PARTY
columns.description: Responsible Party for the given Deliverable. Valid Values are SUPPLIER_ORG or BUYER_ORG. Refers to the RESP_PARTY_CODE in the OKC_DEL_RESP_PARTIES_B table.

columns.name: INTERNAL_PARTY_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the Internal Party contact on a Deliverable

columns.name: EXTERNAL_PARTY_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the External Party contact on a Deliverable

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name for the Deliverable.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Deliverable description

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Notes added on the Deliverable by the internal  user.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The sequence in which the deliverable will appear on a Contract when printed.

columns.name: FIXED_DUE_DATE_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the deliverable has a fixed due date. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: ACTUAL_DUE_DATE
columns.description: The actual date by which the deliverable is due.

columns.name: RECURRING_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the deliverable is one-time or recurring. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: NOTIFY_PRIOR_DUE_DATE_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the number of periods (period type specified by NOTIFY_PRIOR_DUE_DATE_UOM column) prior to the due date by which the Reminder notification  has to be sent.

columns.name: NOTIFY_PRIOR_DUE_DATE_UOM
columns.description: Indicates the  period type (Days, Weeks or Months) prior to the due date by which the Deliverable Reminder notification has to be sent. Refers to LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE = `OKC_DELIVERABLE_TIME_UNITS`.

columns.name: NOTIFY_PRIOR_DUE_DATE_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether a notification needs to be sent prior to the Due Date on the Deliverable.

columns.name: NOTIFY_COMPLETED_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether a notification should be sent upon any change in status of the Deliverable.

columns.name: NOTIFY_OVERDUE_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether a notification needs to be sent if the Deliverable is overdue.

columns.name: NOTIFY_ESCALATION_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether an escalation notification needs to be sent if the Deliverable is overdue.

columns.name: NOTIFY_ESCALATION_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the number of periods (period type specified by the NOTIFY_ESCALATION_UOM column) after the due date by which an escalation notification is to be sent

columns.name: NOTIFY_ESCALATION_UOM
columns.description: Indicates the period type (Days, Weeks or Months) by which an escalation notification is due. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE= `OKC_DELIVERABLE_TIME_UNITS`.

columns.name: ESCALATION_ASSIGNEE
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the Internal Party contact to whom the escalation notification needs to be sent

columns.name: AMENDMENT_OPERATION
columns.description: Code to indicate the type of the amendment performed on the Deliverable. Valid values are ADDED, DELETED and UPDATED. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where  LOOKUP_TYPE= `OKC_AMEND_OPN_CODE`.

columns.name: PRIOR_NOTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier for the Notification sent as Reminder Notification prior to the due date of the Deliverable.

columns.name: AMENDMENT_NOTES
columns.description: Notes to describe the amendment operation performed on the Deliverable.

columns.name: COMPLETED_NOTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier for the Notification sent upon status change of a Deliverable.

columns.name: OVERDUE_NOTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier for the Notification sent when a Deliverable is overdue.

columns.name: ESCALATION_NOTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier for the Notification sent when an overdue Deliverable is escalated.

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Language of the Deliverable

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DELIVERABLE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the original deliverable on which amendments have been performed. This is carried forward across all the versions of that deliverable. This will be used to synchronize status of a deliverable across versions.

columns.name: REQUESTER_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the Internal Party contact who requested the Deliverable.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the External Party on the Deliverable

columns.name: RECURRING_DEL_PARENT_ID
columns.description: Deliverable Id of the recurring Deliverable from which recurring instances are generated.

columns.name: BUSINESS_DOCUMENT_VERSION
columns.description: Business document version for a given Business Document Id

columns.name: RELATIVE_ST_DATE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration before or after the Relative Start Date. The period type is defined by the RELATIVE_ST_DATE_UOM

columns.name: RELATIVE_ST_DATE_UOM
columns.description: Period type for the start date of the due date. Only applicable when the deliverable has a relative start date. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE= `OKC_DELIVERABLE_TIME_UNITS`.

columns.name: RELATIVE_ST_DATE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the start date event. Only applicable when the deliverable has a relative start date. Refers to the EVENT_ID in OKC_BUS_DOC_EVENTS_B

columns.name: RELATIVE_END_DATE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration before or after the Relative End Date. The period type is defined by the RELATIVE_END_DATE_UOM

columns.name: RELATIVE_END_DATE_UOM
columns.description: Period type for the end date of the due date. Only applicable when the deliverable has a relative end date. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE= `OKC_DELIVERABLE_TIME_UNITS`.

columns.name: RELATIVE_END_DATE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the end date event. Refers to EVENT_ID in OKC_BUS_DOC_EVENTS_B

columns.name: REPEATING_DAY_OF_MONTH
columns.description: Day of the month the deliverable will repeat. Refers to LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE=` OKC_DAY_OF_MONTH `

columns.name: REPEATING_DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: Day of the week the deliverable will repeat. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE= `DAY_OF_WEEK`.

columns.name: REPEATING_FREQUENCY_UOM
columns.description: Repeating frequency for a recurring deliverable.. Used in conjunction with the REPEATING_DURATION column to define the repeating frequency. Example: 3 months. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE= `OKC_DEL_REPEAT_FREQ`.

columns.name: REPEATING_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the repeating frequency for a recurring deliverable. Used in conjunction with REPEATING_FREQUENCY_UOM. Example: 3 months

columns.name: FIXED_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the deliverable when the start date is fixed.

columns.name: FIXED_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the deliverable when the end date is fixed.

columns.name: MANAGE_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the deliverable is active and if it can be managed/fulfilled. Valid values are Y and N

columns.name: INTERNAL_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Internal party on the deliverable.

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_STATUS
columns.description: Current status of this Deliverable. Refers to LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE= `OKC_DELIVERABLE_STATUS`

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_NOTES
columns.description: Notes provided by the responsible party as part of managing the deliverable

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DISABLE_NOTIFICATIONS_YN
